pages.text: $(o)The bones of a sun-king, still crowned, at the bottom of the $(l)Cursed Pyramid$() in the deserts of the Wildlands.$()$(br2)$(l)Counter:$() It charges in straight lines. Roll aside late and punish it while it turns.$(br2)Never fight it in a corridor. Give yourselves room to step aside.
$(l)Defeated.$()$(br2)Its $(item)Sun-Bleached Fang$() counts for the quest book, and its quest marks the way to the Frontier.
